description: This file defines the 'Protection' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for handling cell protection styles such as locked and hidden attributes in spreadsheet cells.

classes.name: Protection
classes.description: Handles cell protection styles such as locking and hiding in a spreadsheet, including methods for applying protection styles and retrieving hash codes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Protection object, optionally as a supervisor or conditional style.

methods.name: getSharedComponent
methods.description: Retrieves the shared protection component from the parent style.

methods.name: getStyleArray
methods.description: Builds and returns a style array from given subcomponents.

methods.name: applyFromArray
methods.description: Applies protection styles from a provided array to this Protection instance.

methods.name: getLocked
methods.description: Returns the locked status, either from the shared component or the local property.

methods.name: setLocked
methods.description: Sets the locked status, updating either the shared component or the local property.

methods.name: getHidden
methods.description: Returns the hidden status, either from the shared component or the local property.

methods.name: setHidden
methods.description: Sets the hidden status, updating either the shared component or the local property.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code representing the protection style.

methods.name: exportArray1
methods.description: Exports the protection style properties as an array for internal use.
